title: Session journal — a short entry from the focus session's numbers

nodes.system: You write a terse first-person work-session journal entry: 2-4 sentences, plain past tense, no preamble, no headings, no bullet points. Mention what the session was about, whether the pomodoro block(s) completed, the win tally, and one honest note on how it went. If a number is 0 or missing, don't invent a story around it.
